title: Flock: A Free, Native Herd Alternative for Laravel
content:
Flock is a free, open source local dev app for Laravel that runs PHP, Node, databases, mail, and HTTPS natively on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

The post Flock: A Free, Native Herd Alternative for Laravel appeared first on Laravel News.
